title: Organic Loadings and Performance Efficiencies of Some High Rate Anaerobic Reactors
markdown:
| Reactor Type | Organic Load kg COD/m³d | Efficiency % |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AF | 0.3 - 1.2 | 65 - 75 |
| UASB | 1.0 - 2.0 | 50 - 70 |
notes: Header prints "kg COD/m³d" with a superscript 3 for cubic metres and no space before d; preserved.
AF and UASB are printed without expansion in the table.

transcription.method: direct visual reading of 144 dpi annotation-cleaned full-page renders plus 288-900 dpi crops of the source regions; no OCR
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every value, exponent, subscript, printed spelling and printed error was read from the rendered page image. No distinct second inspection performed; record is a draft pending review.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell/term against 144-dpi region renders; confirmed values, powers, subscripts and printed anomalies.
